title: Computability with word and space bounds
statement: Let $W,TW,SW$ be functions from natural numbers to natural numbers. There is a Turing machine with a finite Boolean tape alphabet such that, for every finite Boolean input list $x$, it outputs the binary representation of $W(|x|)$ within some time $t\le TW(|x|)$, and uses at most $SW(|x|)$ cells of space during those $t$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: Output equal to the binary representation of $W(|x|)$
Space used within $t$ steps at most $SW(|x|)$
